searchText: I personally find it incredibly annoying when the server responds in a language I told them I don't understand. So many things have broken for me in client dev because a server doesn't respect the handshake. Most often this is in the form of an API that returns HTML in error responses (usually because they have some edge termination server that errorud instead of the server I am actually talking to). https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/pull/539
